method: Read-only review of the complete runtime diff, related state/render/audio/service call sites and regression evidence after implementation, using review-agent instructions. Performed by the implementation agent, not an independent reviewer. Implementation fixes were made outside the read-only review.
resolvedFindings: Guard null tyre entries when migrating malformed saves.
Keep ground height separate from the stance caused by tyre deflation during reset.
Include dissipated deflated-tyre rolling work in the thermal energy ledger.
Follow signed wheel rotation in damaged-tyre rolling sound.
Keep tyre-only repair geometry above ground without adding its update to debris processing.
Wrap pressure/casing/flat-spot readouts within the diagnostic column at desktop and narrow width.
Correct UTF-8 copying of the goal-coverage parser, then verify all 156 requirements verbatim.
limits: Fixed-volume pressure proxy and one shared tyre/air temperature, a single dominant flat spot, no detailed belt/tear model or inflation service.
Radial rubber deformation, retained nominal shape for fully detached wheel debris; no independent rim condition.
Software renderer, no subjective listening, physical wheel or live multi-PC network test.
CPU measurement excludes world/GPU/AI/audio and does not establish an FPS guarantee.
visualCheck: Garage: existing car and sport-tyre purchase render with the saved tyre condition.
Condition panel: pressure, casing and flat-spot values fit their rows at 1440px and 390px viewport width.
Existing drive/map and aero/drivetrain previews render; wide-scale district-label crowding remains a pre-existing map limitation.
